status: adapter isolado implementado; primeira CI falhou somente na validação de metadados; correção publicada e aguardando nova CI

cards.name: Curse of Royal
cards.officialEffect: Negate the activation and the effect of a Spell or Trap Card that includes the effect of destroying 1 Spell or Trap Card and destroy it.
adapterBehavior: Only responds to the current opponent Spell/Trap activation when a typed effect descriptor explicitly states that it destroys exactly one Spell/Trap.
Rejects monster effects, same-team activations, already-negated links, missing descriptors, and destroy-all effects.
Negates the activation/effect and destroys the activated physical card when the exact response link and card lifetime remain current.
Routes both the Counter Trap and destroyed card to their physical owner's team Graveyard, including stolen cards and inactive partners.
Uses a serializable activation session and bounded anti-replay receipt list.

implementation.integrationBoundary: Pure isolated adapter. Host must provide the typed destroysExactlyOneSpellTrap descriptor from an authoritative effect model; central Chain/resolver integration awaits explicit M61 handoff.

catalogAtStart.status: baseline do checkpoint compartilhado; revalidar via CI

limitations: Curse of Royal permanece fora do catálogo, metadata, certificações e allowlist; testes usam Trap já habilitada como fixture.
O adapter não é chamado pelo resolver central; a camada host deve fornecer o descritor de efeito confiável e a janela Chain.
Não há integração de comandos Discord nem validação de gateway/guild ao vivo.
Nenhuma concessão de inventário, alteração de dados persistentes, merge ou deploy.
